data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* code_version: bed2cd519c7a8bf20ccbf645fe2ceb87ab8d219b
* script: plugins/dso/scripts/ci/review-convergence-check.sh (W2c oscillation detection + cycle cap; exit 1 STALL/escalate). Referenced ONLY in WORKFLOW-STABILITY-CHECKS.md (docs) — NOT in .github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml, not in any CI workflow, not in required-checks.txt.

### 2. Incident Overview
* Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker (autonomous dogfood discovery during 29e7->main)

#### Expected Behavior
The review loop should have a convergence/oscillation brake: when findings oscillate (flagged->cleared->flagged) or exceed a cycle cap, it should STALL/escalate rather than churn.

#### Actual Behavior
review-sub-pr on PR1 #631 oscillated across 4 cycles (6->3->3->3 findings), degrading from real defects to a phantom-concurrency race, a scope-creep test ask, and a doc nit — never converged; required FP-recovery. The convergence brake EXISTS as a script but is wired into nothing, so the loop ran unbraked. Fix: wire review-convergence-check.sh into review-sub-pr.yml (or the review loop driver). RELATED GAP (G-B): FP-RECOVERY-WORKFLOW.md Step 0/5a key on the main-targeting llm-review check, NOT review-sub-pr (the sub-PR gate on a different ruleset) — the escape valve is not written for the check that actually gated PR1; this session adapted it manually. Likely belongs to the review-convergence/arbiter epic (a7aa is brainstorm/plan-review, a different surface).
data.title: [review-sub-pr]: review-convergence-check.sh built but wired nowhere -> review loop has no oscillation brake
